verdict.rationale: Trademark filing explicitly requires a USPTO.gov account with MFA and identity verification before you can access TEAS or Trademark Center. The only keyless trademark path is a form preview, which is an adjacent feature and does not start the filing flow. Patent Center's wording that 'only as a registered user' can you view, track and respond to your submission implies unregistered users can submit, but that keyless filing path is implied rather than explicitly documented. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented no-account or file-number entry into the core filing flow, a trademark-side keyless path, and hands-on corroboration that unregistered patent submission works.
